items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I went to rehearsal with them and, uh, they seemed to like me. And I went to work with them, with their band. I played quite a number of years with them.

ctx.x: I went to rehearsal with them and, uh, they seemed to like me. And I went to work with them, with their band. I played quite a number of years with them. Then, uh, Eddie Jackson, supreme, uh, band, was working on, uh, the music box, Crowlet and Canal.
